title: Fourier-to-binary function conversion
statement: For a function $p$ on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, define a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional binary cube by assigning to each input $x$ the value $(1-p(s(x)))/2$, where $s(x)$ is the corresponding sign vector.
